name: Box Jump
steps: Stand about a foot in front of a sturdy, low box.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and forward, swinging your arms up.
Land softly on the box with both feet, knees bent.
Stand tall, then step down one foot at a time.
cues: Land softly, whole foot on the box
Step down, do not jump down

common_mistakes.fix: Pick a height you can land on in a half squat
Step down to protect your knees and ankles
Land with knees pushed out over toes
